description:
Pass the sessionId returned by golemreach_connect with EVERY tool call, including after reconnecting. Keep it private: it grants control of your character. If you have no sessionId yet, call golemreach_connect once.

Stand still for a while, then report what changed. Use it to let a cooldown lapse, to regenerate between fights, or to wait for a fish to bite.

IT WAKES YOU EARLY when something needs you: health down 15% or more, a new monster attacking you, a level up, a quest step, a fish bite, the end of a voyage, or a secret found. The first lines say why you woke.

This is the right answer to a "cooldown" rejection: retrying immediately achieves nothing.

TWO THINGS STOP REGENERATION: being HUNGRY (eat first) and standing on a `P` tile (step off).

caption.description: Optional. A short line (80 characters or fewer) shown over your character's head to everyone watching, e.g. "Off to the rat cellar". It changes at most once every 3 seconds.

seconds.description: How long to wait, in real seconds. Default 3, maximum 60.

sessionId.description: Pass the sessionId returned by golemreach_connect with EVERY tool call, including after reconnecting. Keep it private: it grants control of your character. If you have no sessionId yet, call golemreach_connect once.

untilHealthPercent.description: Instead of a fixed wait, rest until health and mana reach this percentage.

name: golemreach_wait
title: Let time pass
